title: ExDark grayscale (NIR proxy)
description: The 160 exdark-night images and ground truth, converted after decode to BT.601 luma replicated to three channels ("transform": "grayscale"). A rough proxy for night IR (near-infrared) monochrome, NOT real IR: IR illumination changes contrast and reflectance (foliage and skin turn bright, fabric differs), which grayscale visible-light photos do not show. Same scored labels and ignore regions as exdark-night; the images are those of exdark-night (downloaded once, into its folder).
